market_summary: USD pairs display consistent bearish pressure during London session, highlighted by GBPUSD breaking cleanly below VAL and previous lows with negative CVD alignment. US100 continues its steady bullish trend above VWAP/EMA50, testing session highs. Gold, EURUSD, and BTCUSD remain stuck in tight consolidation ranges or exhibit CVD volume divergence near key S/R boundaries, favoring selective execution on GBPUSD short and US100 long.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4040.95 to VAH 4060.33) and below POC 4047.0. CVD is BEARISH (-1.38) with negative slope (-0.77), agreeing with downside pressure during LONDON_SESSION. Price rejected near S/R 4052.38 and is trading below VWAP (4048.84) and EMA50 (4050.93), holding mid-channel without strong RVOL spike (rvol 1.163). Weak direction inside VA warrants HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.11315 to VAH 1.11621) and trading below POC 1.11382 during LONDON_SESSION. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1490) despite a positive slope, creating mild divergence. Price is below VWAP (1.11515) and EMA50 (1.11532), testing near the lower ATR band (1.11329) and hovering near Session Low (1.11307) without an RVOL breakout spike (0.962). Prefer HOLD inside value area.

Price is positioned below VAL 1.33196 and below POC 1.33473, breaking under Prev Low 1.33119 toward Session Low 1.3307. CVD is strongly BEARISH (-1941) with negative slope (-519.53), fully aligned with price. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (1.33312) and EMA50 (1.33344), pressing the lower ATR band (1.331) with high relative volume (RVOL 1.813, close to 2.0 expansion). Strong downside momentum confluence.
signals.level_event: breakout acceptance below VAL and Prev Low 1.33119

signals.rationale: Price is inside the upper Value Area (VAL 28023.92 to VAH 28294.33) and above POC 28115.86. CVD is BULLISH (+9.20) with positive slope (+0.91), agreeing with upward trend during LONDON_SESSION. Price is cleanly above VWAP (28092.21) and EMA50 (28095.76), testing the upper ATR band (28287.87) near Session High. Dukascopy tick volume rarely prints RVOL > 2.0 (currently 0.943), but structural trend alignment above EMA20/50 supports momentum scalping.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish well above VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH 73828.35 and above POC 73660.4 during LONDON_SESSION. However, CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) with negative slope (-0.01), showing divergence against price expansion. Price is above VWAP (73669.22) and EMA50 (73729.05), but struggling to push past resistance S/R 73975.3 and Session High 74085.2 without volume confirmation (RVOL 0.985, 0 spikes). Divergence and lack of volume mandate HOLD.
